definitions.explanation: A person who deceives others to obtain money or valuables through dishonest means.

examples.japanese: {詐欺師|さぎし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{騙|だま}された→騙す：02286_damasu⟧。
examples.english: I was deceived by a con artist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{詐欺師|さぎし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was arrested as a swindler.

examples.japanese: {詐欺師|さぎし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{巧|たく}み→巧み：07153_takumi⟧な⟦{話術|わじゅつ}→話術：21732_wajutsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{騙|だま}す→騙す：02286_damasu⟧。
examples.english: Con artists deceive people with skillful rhetoric.

notes:
A person who deceives others for money or profit. Strongly negative — calling someone a {詐欺師|さぎし} is a serious accusation.

FORMS:
⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧ (fraud, swindle) + {師|し} (master, expert — here ironic, implying skill at deception).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {詐欺師|さぎし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{騙|だま}される→騙す：02286_damasu⟧: to be deceived by a con artist
- {詐欺師|さぎし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}される→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧: to be arrested as a swindler
- ⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧{詐欺師|さぎし}: genius con artist

- ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧{罪|ざい}: the crime of fraud
